name: Bluesky Post
description: Adds a per-node "Share to Bluesky" tab that posts a node's title, summary and link to Bluesky via the bsky module.
project_description:
This module adds a UI to the Bluesky Integration (bsky) module, which provides Drupal services for the potibm/phluesky library — a PHP client for Bluesky social using the AT Protocol.

 Features 
 Adds a "Share to Bluesky" tab to the tabs (local tasks) of selected node types. The tab opens a form pre-filled with the node's Title, body Summary (or the first 300 characters of the body), and an absolute Link to the node, all of which can be edited before posting to Bluesky.

 Post-Installation 
 The settings page lets a site administrator choose which content types show the "Share to Bluesky" tab. Separate permissions gate configuration and posting.

 Additional Requirements 
 drupal/bsky — the Bluesky Integration module, which in turn requires the potibm/phluesky library and holds the single Bluesky handle + app-password credential.

 Notice 
 The module is really only of value on a single-user system: bsky stores one credential for authenticating to Bluesky, so every post goes to that one account regardless of who triggers it. Multi-user support is noted by the maintainer as a future goal.
